title: Not the First One but the Eleventh
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：wave　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wave 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① wave that took the boat was not the biggest of that day, and my grandfather said that is always how it goes: not the first one but the eleventh. He had gone out at six with a ② wave of the hand to my grandmother, who had not looked up, and who said afterwards that she had not looked up because she had known, and no wave, he used to say, ever comes alone.
A ③ wave of cold came off the sea in February 1962 and killed the early potatoes on eleven farms, and my grandmother said the sea has no memory of what it does.

He explained the ④ wave to me with a rope on the garden path: he shook one end and the rope did not travel, and he said that is the whole of it — the water stays and the shape goes, and the wave had been eleven feet. My grandmother had a ⑤ wave in her hair until 1974, put in every Thursday with eleven pins, and she took the pins out the day he drowned and never put them back.

She ⑥ waved to him from the door every morning for thirty-one years, and once, on the eleventh of June, she did not, and that is the part of the story I cannot bear and cannot leave alone. In 1971 there was a ⑦ wave of anger about the harbour: eleven meetings, and nothing was built, and my grandmother said a meeting is a wave that goes nowhere.

In 1979 I ⑧ waved goodbye to my own daughter at the same door, and I understood then what the door was for. The ⑨ wave I remember best is not the one that took the boat but the one I saw at eleven, from the cliff, when the sea was flat and there was nothing in it at all. The ⑩ wave of 1953, meaning the flood that took eleven houses along this coast, is the one my grandmother talked about, though she had never seen it, and she described it every year for thirty-one years.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 挥手；挥动（的动作）
C. n. （寒潮、洪水等的）一阵；一波
D. n. 波（物理上的波：水波、绳波、声波）
G. 固定搭配：a wave of ... （情绪、抗议等的）浪潮
H. 固定搭配：wave goodbye（to ...）（向……）挥手告别

items.q: The wave that took the boat
with a wave of the hand
A wave of cold came off the sea
He explained the wave to me with a rope
My grandmother had a wave in her hair
She waved to him from the door
there was a wave of anger
I waved goodbye to my own daughter

answers.why: the wave 意为“海浪、波浪”，打翻那条船的浪不是那天最大的一个，而是第十一个。
a wave of the hand 意为“挥手（的动作）”，他六点出门时朝祖母挥了挥手，而她没有抬头。
a wave of cold 意为“一股寒潮、一阵寒冷”，1962 年 2 月一股寒潮从海上袭来。
the wave 意为“（物理上的）波”，他用花园小路上的一根绳子给我解释波：水没有走，走的是形状。
a wave 意为“（头发的）波浪、卷曲”，祖母到 1974 年为止头发一直烫着波浪，每周四用十一枚发针固定。
waved 是动词，意为“挥手”，她三十一年里每天早上都在门口向他挥手。
a wave of anger 意为“一阵愤怒的浪潮”，1971 年围绕港口掀起了一阵愤怒的浪潮，开了十一次会。
wave goodbye 意为“挥手告别”，1979 年我在同一个门口向自己的女儿挥手告别。
the wave 意为“海浪”，我记得最清楚的那个浪不是打翻船的那个。
the wave of 1953 意为“1953 年那一波（洪水）”，指那年沿海冲毁十一户人家的洪水。
